aboutParagraphs: Hi, I'm Abhishek J N — a Full-Stack Software Engineer contributing to digital transformation initiatives at Deloitte India for Eli Lilly in Bengaluru.

I build performant, cloud-native web and AI-powered applications using React.js, Node.js, Python (Flask/FastAPI), REST APIs, Docker, and AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, EC2, ECS, EKS, DynamoDB, S3, Glue, Textract, SES, and SNS.

My focus is on end-to-end AI engineering: creating polished frontend experiences, scalable backend services, document-intelligence workflows, RAG applications, and LLM-powered solutions using the ChatGPT API, LangChain, LangGraph, embeddings, and vector databases.
I enjoy translating complex enterprise workflows into secure, reliable, and high-performance products that deliver measurable business value.
